P(cumulative LoE of AR ≤ 1), Theoretical Limit
note: P(within AR) = 0.609 (Wilson 0.596-0.623); (b) threshold 6.69 M (95% CI 6.69-6.70 M; Firth penalised likelihood (MLE does not exist), 2000 resamples). L1 at TL, the national 1991 household size 2.79, implies 11.7% fewer households per person at every age than the 2023 census rates in 2050. With L1 at TL from the lowest observed census headship of each age group (or propensity B where lower; 4.0% fewer) TL is 5,963 kt, LoE AR 1.35, P(LoE AR ≤ 1) = 0.04% over the draws (sensitivity row).
